subject.title: ci: stress race detection with a GOMAXPROCS sweep and repeat count

question: Should Turnwire permanently accept the proposed GOMAXPROCS 2/8 and `-count=5` race-test cadence, with its increased recurring hosted-runner cost?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proof-backed, but acceptable CI duration and runner budget are repository policy choices that code review cannot resolve safely.

options.title: Accept the bounded stress cadence
options.body: Merge the current focused workflow change and monitor CI duration after it lands.

options.title: Use a lighter cadence
options.body: Ask for a narrower repeat count or schedule the heavier race sweep outside every pull request before merging.

options.title: Pause the change
options.body: Keep the existing race cadence until maintainers define an explicit CI budget for stress testing.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded stress cadence
recommendation.body: Merge the current focused workflow change and monitor CI duration after it lands.
